exercises.q: What does с- add in сбро́сить (“to throw down, to drop”)?
options: the limit, the result of the action itself
shared participation in something, or shared belonging
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сбро́сить under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does с- add in спры́гнуть (“to jump off, to leap off”)?
options: shared participation in something, or shared belonging
the limit, the result of the action itself
movement from different sides to one point
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists спры́гнуть under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does с- add in слете́ть (“to fly down (from), to fly away (from)”)?
options: place or manner of an action
shared participation in something, or shared belonging
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists слете́ть under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does с- add in сойти́ (“to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off”)?
options: place or manner of an action
movement from different sides to one point
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сойти́ under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

**сойти** — сойти́ (perfective): to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from; to pass by; (figuratively) to pass for, to be taken for. Wiktionary: со- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сошёл** — сойти́ (perfective): to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from; to pass by; (figuratively) to pass for, to be taken for. Wiktionary: со- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to jump off, to leap off
to fly down (from), to fly away (from)
to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сбро́сить — to throw down, to drop; спры́гнуть — to jump off, to leap off; слете́ть — to fly down (from), to fly away (from); сойти́ — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off.

exercises.q: What does о- add in обру́шиться (“to fall in, to collapse”)?
options: the limit, completeness, result of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists обру́шиться under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).

exercises.q: What does о- add in осе́сть (“to settle, to sink”)?
options: turning into something, giving it particular properties
spreading the action over the whole object, its whole surface or volume
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists осе́сть under this meaning of о-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «о-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/о-).
**свело** — свести́ (perfective): to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together; to reduce (to), to bring (to); to remove. Wiktionary: с- + вести́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **свёл** — свести́ (perfective): to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together; to reduce (to), to bring (to); to remove. Wiktionary: с- + вести́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does с- add in сговори́ться (“to come to terms, to come to an agreement”)?
options: place or manner of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сговори́ться under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does раз- add in разойти́сь (“to go away, to disperse (in different directions), to spread”)?
options: alternative form of раз- (used before certain consonant clusters)
(used with verbs, in the negative) not quite
alternative form of раз- (before voiceless consonants)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists разойти́сь under this meaning of раз-. Source: Wiktionary, «раз-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/раз-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to come to terms, to come to an agreement
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: обру́шиться — to fall in, to collapse; осе́сть — to settle, to sink; свести́ — to lead, to take (from somewhere); сговори́ться — to come to terms, to come to an agreement.
